discovered_signals.text: A solo professional reports spending substantial time responding to inquiries that do not match the services actually offered.
A small professional practice is publicly comparing several software subscriptions but lacks a consistent cost and feature analysis.
A small workshop asks peers how they track changing supplier prices and lead times for recurring materials.
A volunteer group says its donation and attendance records are spread across several inconsistent spreadsheets.

offers.scope: Consolidate the volunteer group's donation and attendance records from multiple spreadsheets into one clean, unified spreadsheet with consistent columns (donor/attendee name, date, amount/attendance status, event). Deliverable: a single organized CSV/table plus a short summary of totals and any data inconsistencies found.
